notes: Production/main and central TAKY canonical remain unchanged
Confirmed Ready & Set timer visual authority is preserved: yellow focus field, full analog clock, mission, remaining/target, pause/complete, BGM and conditional REC
Timestamp-based session timing remains authoritative across focus and recording round trips
Confirmed timetable context feeds the today-task selection path without treating unlisted time as free time
Focus audio options keep Essential, metronome, nature, water and off; noisy lofi is removed
Recording capture enables browser/device echo cancellation, noise suppression and automatic gain control and stops BGM before microphone capture
The first encoded browser capture is preserved as ORIGINAL before any Ready & Set post-processing
A separate CLEAN copy is generated locally with high-pass/low-pass filtering, adaptive soft gate, mild compression, peak normalization and mono PCM16 WAV encoding
Local CLEAN processing uses no paid API, no cloud processing and normally finishes while the review screen is already available; transfer waits at most 800 ms before falling back to ORIGINAL
ORIGINAL and CLEAN are stored separately in IndexedDB and CLEAN records link back to sourceOriginalId
Recording transfer prefers CLEAN when available and falls back to ORIGINAL without blocking the learning session
Start-share and completion-share generate image-first PNG cards from verified task/status/timing data and sharing does not write session/task state
Incomplete outcomes remain PARTIAL / DEFERRED / BLOCKED / WAITING_FOR_PARENT rather than being forced to complete
Zero-cost / zero-wait local optimization is the default for most runtime features; character generation and Guide/Explorer-team generation are explicit exceptions

Automated source-level exploration contract plus full-app browser E2E cover timer, pause/resume, recording, original persistence, local clean generation, transfer, reload recovery, completion truth and result image share
Real iPhone microphone acoustics, native iOS share sheet, YouTube playback, background/screen-lock continuity and visual fidelity remain device-validation pending
